AGRICULTURE — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #4
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Integrated Farming? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Integrated Farming.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Integrated Farming.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Integrated Farming.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Integrated Farming.

3. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Iron rusting

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Organic Gardening? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Organic Gardening.

   A. Only water vapour
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Glucose and oxygen

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix.

8. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities.

   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Storage of Crop Produce.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Storage of Crop Produce.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Storage of Crop Produce.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Storage of Crop Produce.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art.

12. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. joule (J)
   C. watt (W)
   D. newton (N)

13. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 100 °C

14. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

15. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Tertiary consumers

16. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Gr? (1 mark)

   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.

20. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Water always increases oxygen

21. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Overgrazing continuously

22. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Leftover Food? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Leftover Food.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Leftover Food.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Leftover Food.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Leftover Food.
